releaseNotes:
NextGenSoftware.OASIS.API.Providers.SOLANAOASIS v2.0.5

Connects the OASIS to Solana -- capable of 65,000+ transactions per second with sub-second finality and sub-cent fees. Stores OASIS holons, avatars, NFTs, and token data on Solana programs. Ideal for high-frequency OASIS data workloads. Part of the OASIS HOT-Swappable Provider Architecture -- switch providers at runtime, zero code changes. Ecosystem: https://oasisomniverse.one

What's new since v2.0.4
- Add server-authoritative OLAND checkout and recover historical Karma audits (613c56e)
- Add Solana SPL token creation via the token-issuer capability (7e20c87)
- Add verified read-only Solana native fee receipts (bbd29d0)
- Add verified read-only Solana public account CQL source (b271bea)
- Export authentic stored Solana holons instead of guessed program accounts (45cd207)
